### When Your Heart Feels Unsteady
Author: Rev. Kyle Norman  
Site: Crosswalk.com  
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/your-nightly-prayer/when-your-heart-feels-unsteady.html  
Passage: Psalm 94:18  
Points:
- Spiritual journeys often pass through disorienting places of fear and uncertainty.
- Feeling shaky does not signal an absent God or failed faith.
- God speaks His steadfast love specifically to uphold us when our footing falters.
- Scripture's promises provide solid steps to walk through discouraging seasons.

### When You're Carrying Quiet Anxiety
Author: Chelsey DeMatteis  
Site: Crosswalk.com  
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/your-nightly-prayer/when-youre-carrying-quiet-anxiety.html  
Passage: Psalm 94:19  
Points:
- Many believers wrestle secretly with quiet, burdensome worry.
- The enemy exploits fear to silence believers and diminish their witness.
- God's comforting presence meets internal distress with His supernatural joy and peace.
- Inviting the Lord into deep vulnerabilities breaks the paralyzing grip of anxious thoughts.

### No Fear! Part One
Author: Pastor Chuck Swindoll  
Site: Insight for Living  
URL: https://insight.org/resources/daily-devotional/individual/no-fear!-part-one  
Passage: Psalm 94:19  
Points:
- Distressing world events and disasters easily ignite nocturnal worry and fear.
- God remains in sovereign control and is never surprised by catastrophes.
- As the Creator and Potter, God does not owe finite people an explanation.
- Recalling that God alone is our refuge brings calm and delights the troubled soul.
